why: WriteOnce checks that a file does not exist and then creates it, a textbook check-then-use race. Every path it gets is inside the run's own scratch directory: internal/stage/workdir.go creates it with os.MkdirTemp, which makes it mode 0700 under a random name, and only this process writes there, one step at a time (Run in internal/stage/run.go). No other user can create or swap a file between the check and the write.
